findings.claim: Line 124 has incorrect operator precedence that allows the OR expression's second part to match ANY line with working-directory: toy as next line, regardless of whether current line is npm ci
findings.evidence: Expression `/^\s*run:\s*npm ci\s*$/.test(l) && /working-directory:\s*toy\/\?\s*$/.test(lines[i - 1] || '') || /working-directory:\s*toy\/\?\s*$/.test(lines[i + 1] || '')` is parsed as `(A && B) || C` instead of `(A && (B || C))`, meaning second part matches if ANY line has `working-directory: toy` as next line without requiring current line to be `npm ci`

findings.claim: AC-6 test's toyInstallAlt regex has a logic error where the second OR clause does not require the current line to be a run: command
findings.evidence: Line 124: `const toyInstallAlt = lines.findIndex((l, i) => /^\s*run:\s*npm ci\s*$/.test(l) && /working-directory:\s*toy\/?\s*$/.test(lines[i - 1] || '') || /working-directory:\s*toy\/?\s*$/.test(lines[i + 1] || ''))` - Due to operator precedence, this parses as `(condition1 && condition2) || condition3` where condition3 checks only if the next line has working-directory:, without requiring the current line to be npm ci. This would match any line preceding a working-directory: toy line. The fix is to wrap the OR part in parentheses: `... && (/working-directory:...test(lines[i - 1] || '') || /working-directory:...test(lines[i + 1] || ''))`
findings.dedupe_key: substrate/test/ci-workflow.test.js:124|toyInstallAlt operator precedence logic error allows non-npm-ci lines to match

findings.claim: AC-8 test asserts in line 129 that it checks for the alternative form (npm test with working-directory: toy) but only implements the primary form (cd toy && npm test)
findings.evidence: Line 129 assertion message: "a step must run the toy suite as `cd toy && npm test` (or npm test with working-directory: toy)" but line 155 only searches for `/^\s*run:\s*cd toy(?:\/)? && npm test\s*$/`. The test lacks a toyInstallAlt-style fallback pattern for the alternative form. If an implementation used `working-directory: toy` on one line and `run: npm test` on another (which the spec explicitly allows in AC-8), the test would fail the assertion at line 156 even though the implementation would conform to the spec.
findings.dedupe_key: substrate/test/ci-workflow.test.js:155|AC-8 test incomplete for alternative npm test working-directory form
